angle_en: eva: only, making Bhishma the sole center

en.intro: After sizing up the two armies, Duryodhana gives his first command. Listen for how he places one man at the center of the entire battle plan.
en.notice: Listen to the word eva, only. He does not tell them to protect the army or the king, but to protect only Bhishma, making the grandfather the single pillar holding up every warrior.
en.next: Sanjaya then tells Dhritarashtra that Bhishma, the grandfather, roars and blows his conch to fill Duryodhana with joy.
en.meaning: Remain at your stations on every front and protect Bhishma from all sides.

hi.intro: दोनों सेनाओं को देखने के बाद, दुर्योधन अपना पहला आदेश देता है। सुनिए, कैसे वह एक ही व्यक्ति को पूरी युद्ध-योजना के केंद्र में रखता है।
hi.meaning: दुर्योधन कहता है, आप सभी मोर्चों पर अपनी-अपनी जगह पर दृढ़ता से स्थित रहें और चारों ओर से पितामह भीष्म की ही रक्षा करें।
hi.notice: सब अपने मोर्चे पर डटकर भीष्म की ही रक्षा करें
hi.next: संजय फिर धृतराष्ट्र को बताते हैं कि पितामह भीष्म शेर की तरह दहाड़े और अपना शंख जोर से बजाया, जिससे दुर्योधन खुश हो गया।

en.intro: After sizing up the two armies, Duryodhana gives his first command. Listen for how he places one man at the center of the entire battle plan.
en.body: Remain at your stations on every front and protect Bhishma from all sides. Listen to the word eva, only. He does not tell them to protect the army or the king, but to protect only Bhishma, making the grandfather the single pillar holding up every warrior. Sanjaya then tells Dhritarashtra that Bhishma, the grandfather, roars and blows his conch to fill Duryodhana with joy.

issues: borrowed: "Listen to the word eva, only. He does not tell them to protect the army or the king, but to protect only Bhishma, making the grandfather the single pillar holding up every warrior." (This notice presents the content of the PREVIOUS verse (10), which compares the sufficiency of the two armies, rather than the meaning of the current verse (11).
